subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` plus `computerUseProviderMetadata` as the public metadata-only Computer Use manifest contract with this field shape and permission semantics?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but it freezes plugin-author API surface and is intended to inform host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after docs and boundary confirmation
options.body: Regenerate `docs/docs_map.md`, rerun docs checks, and confirm that host code will use the metadata only as pre-runtime discovery data before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before publishing the plugin contract.

options.title: Use the rebased companion branch
options.body: If maintainers prefer the rebased stack, carry the work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 and close this PR only after that path is merge-viable.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs and boundary confirmation
recommendation.body: Regenerate `docs/docs_map.md`, rerun docs checks, and confirm that host code will use the metadata only as pre-runtime discovery data before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed ownership of the manifest/docs surface and authored the rebased companion branch.
